review_description: From the time the system was installed the inverter has not worked correctly so that it keeps switching back to the grid and on average only generates less than 2 kwh each day.  I have twice contacted the installer and they are waiting to hear back from the supplier of the inverter.  Green B rang up two days after the system had been erected and wanted the rest of their money.  However I have refused to pay until it is operating as it should.  Only at that time will I regard the system as being fully installed.Still waiting for the inspection from the power company and to find out if we need a new smart meter, so I can contact our electricity retailer to negotiate a feed in price.  I am a bit frustrated by the whole experience so far and am hoping that it will improve in the future.
6 weeks after I have signed up still not installed.
